decisions_this_session.decision: Camera pipeline 'wrong camera' issue was misdiagnosed initially. Continuity Camera index shift hypothesis was wrong on this hardware — both AVFoundation legacy (devicesWithMediaType_ + sortByUniqueID) and modern (AVCaptureDeviceDiscoverySession with explicit AVCaptureDeviceTypeContinuityCamera) APIs agree: wrist USB cam = cv2 idx 0.
decisions_this_session.rationale: Verified empirically via cv2-enumerate-cameras package (modern API) + manual PyObjC enumeration (legacy API) — both returned identical [USB2.0_CAM1, FaceTime, iPhone] order. The 'opens but yields zero frames' symptom was transient and cleared by Terminal.app handoff via camera_pipeline_start.sh.

decisions_this_session.decision: Reverted my own find_camera.py 'auto-shift' hardening to upstream master (commit 2237d46).
